summary: Native admission protects configured cgroups from pressure without treating admitted jobs' self-throttling as host distress.

schema.detail: Optional protected/excluded cgroup policy paths and source-path details are added to local pressure evidence. No SQL migration or client-v0 schema change.

rules.detail: Memory and I/O PSI use the maximum over protected cgroups. Defaults discover the daemon cgroup, system.slice, and interactive app.slice, excluding app-lanes.slice and gate.slice. Exclusion-aware child enumeration is refreshed every sample, bounded to one level and 256 entries. Vanished children are skipped; unreadable existing protected cgroups, exceeded bounds, and unsupported exclusions fail closed with path-specific evidence. The independent MemAvailable floor, thresholds, sampler cadence, freshness, and recovery hysteresis remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing policy documents use automatic protected-cgroup defaults. Deploy this version before configuring protectedCgroups or excludedCgroups, which older daemons do not understand. Existing membership reason records remain readable.

manual.detail: For nonstandard cgroup layouts, configure psiBrake.protectedCgroups and excludedCgroups with paths relative to the cgroup v2 root. Inspect the retained path-specific reason if automatic discovery or reading fails closed.

recovery.detail: Correct unreadable files or unsupported policy paths; fresh healthy sampler observations recover through the existing hysteresis window.
